spec.goal: Close the cross-scope execution loop: host checks spec_guard_undeclared_deletion (git diff vs plan deletes/renames) and spec_guard_stale_impact (census baseline vs current drift); the ADD-NNN impact-addendum schema + SCOPE_CASCADE_DISCOVERED / ADDENDUM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED reason codes + AMEND-GRANT; wire vv-execute (pre-flight, commit gate, discovery triage paths A/B/C, discovery budget) and vv-review (consumer entry files in dispatch, goal-attainment closeout).
spec.architecture: CLASSIFY_BOUNDARY: domain-only. Changes confined to dsh-vv-spec-guard (src/execute.ts new host checks, src/index.ts tool registration) and agent-presets/skills (vv-execute, vv-review, addendum template). Host checks do git + census I/O; the pure lint engine stays zero-dependency. stale-impact reuses runCensus (baseline+current pair); undeclared-deletion parses git diff --name-status -M.

C-EXECUTE-FEEDBACK.name: Execution feedback
C-EXECUTE-FEEDBACK.responsibility: undeclared-deletion commit gate + stale-impact pre-flight (host); ADD-NNN addendum + reason codes + AMEND-GRANT; vv-execute discovery protocol + vv-review consumer-entry-file dispatch + goal-attainment closeout

testing.strategy: Host-check unit tests against real foundation git history: undeclared-deletion on the teardown diff (341 deletions; declaring a path removes it; unreachable baseline typed error); stale-impact same-ref determinism (no drift, identical digests). Skill frontmatter intact; addendum template parses.
testing.coverage: undeclared-deletion declared/undeclared/unreachable; stale-impact drift/determinism; discovery protocol paths A/B/C; goal-attainment ledger.
